about: Repair Intelligence ki error library. Har entry ka pattern vendored engines ke asal error strings/codes se liya gaya hai (source har entry me darj hai) ya public documented SP Flash Tool error list se hai. Andaze wali entry yahan NAHI jati. Runner har FAIL hue op ke aakhir me log ko in patterns se milata hai aur match par hint deta hai.

hal_steps: Bilkul isi model/chipset ka DA istemal karo (Loaders Library se auto-select ya model ka apna DA)
Cable aur USB port badal kar dekho
Phone ko dobara BROM mode me lagao (band karke Volume dono dabaye hue)
entries.title: DA bhejna fail (CMD_SEND_DA_FAIL)
entries.wajah: BootROM ne Download Agent qabool nahi kiya — DA is chipset/model ke liye nahi hai, ya BROM handshake darmiyan me toota.

hal_steps: Doosra USB port/cable try karo (peeche wala port behtar)
DA file dobara check karo ke kharab/truncated to nahi
Phone dobara BROM me lagao aur battery charge ka khayal rakho
entries.title: DA download fail (DOWNLOAD_DA_FAIL)
entries.wajah: BROM mode me DA ki download mukammal nahi hui — connection unstable ya DA file is device ke BROM se match nahi karti.

hal_steps: Phone poora band karo, phir Volume Up+Down dabaye hue cable lagao
Kuch models par test-point lazmi hota hai — MDM List ke model note me dekho
VCOM driver Device Manager me araha hai ya nahi, check karo
entries.title: BROM start command fail (CMD_STARTCMD_FAIL)
entries.wajah: Phone asal BROM mode me nahi aya — aksar preloader mode me atka hota hai ya button combo ghalat lagta hai.

hal_steps: Bilkul isi model ka stock firmware/preloader istemal karo
Scatter wali mukammal firmware se flash karo, sirf aik file se nahi
Loaders Library se chipset-matched DA dobara chunno
entries.title: DRAM / EMI setup fail
entries.wajah: DA phone ki DRAM shuru nahi kar saka — sab se aam wajah ghalat preloader/firmware (doosre model ki EMI settings).

hal_steps: Device ke asal chipset ke mutabiq DA chuno (Read Info se chip confirm karo)
Doosre brand/model ka DA is phone par mat lagao
entries.title: SoC check fail (SOC_CHECK_FAIL)
entries.wajah: DA aur device ke chipset ka match nahi — ghalat chipset ke liye bana DA laga diya gaya hai.

hal_steps: UTILITY module ka 'Install Drivers' op chalao
Device Manager me MediaTek VCOM port nazar ana chahiye — na aye to driver dobara lagao
Doosre flashing tools band karke dobara try karo (port aik waqt me aik hi program kholta hai)
entries.title: COM port khul nahi saka (COM_PORT_OPEN_FAIL)
entries.wajah: Serial (VCOM) port open nahi hua — driver missing hai ya port kisi aur program ke paas khula hai.

hal_steps: Is model ka Secure Boot DA (stock firmware se harvest kiya hua ya per-model DA) istemal karo
Aam generic DA is model par nahi chalega
entries.title: Secure-boot info nahi mili (SEC_INFO_NOT_FOUND)
entries.wajah: Device ki sec-info DA ko nahi mili — ye secure-boot wale model ki nishani hai jahan model ka signed DA chahiye hota hai.

hal_steps: Cable dobara lagao aur phone ko phir se BROM mode me lao
USB hub hata kar seedha PC ke port me lagao
Driver (VCOM) ki halat Device Manager me check karo
entries.title: BROM timeout (TIMEOUT 0x412)
entries.wajah: BootROM ne waqt par jawab nahi diya — phone mode se nikal gaya, cable hil gayi, ya PC ne port der se khola.

hal_steps: Phone band karke sahi combo (Vol+/Vol- dabaye hue) se dobara lagao
Doosra cable/port try karo
Device Manager me BROM/VCOM port ka ana confirm karo
entries.title: BROM handshake fail
entries.wajah: MTKClient ka BROM handshake mukammal nahi hua — phone sahi mode me nahi, driver masla hai, ya cable beech me hati.

hal_steps: META mode wala rasta try karo (MDM List → Transsion META) — naye models par market bhi wahi jata hai
Model ke route label (MDM List) se dekho ke is par konsa darwaza zinda hai
entries.title: Security bypass fail
entries.wajah: Bypass chain (payload/carbonara/heapbait) is device par kaam nahi ayi — naye security wale models par BROM exploit aksar band hota hai.

hal_steps: Phone power off karke dobara META mode me lagao (engine ki apni hidayat bhi yahi hai)
Cable mat hilao; doosra port try karo
entries.title: META mode sync fail
entries.wajah: META session ka sync toota — phone META me sahi nahi ghusa ya beech me mode badal gaya.

hal_steps: Loaders Library me is brand+chipset ka firehose import karo (Loaders Library Import op)
Firmware Harvest se stock firmware ke andar ka loader nikaal kar darj karo
QC EDL op ka loader note dekho — cross-brand match par tool khud rukta hai, wajah wahi likhi hoti hai
entries.pattern: Couldn't find a suitable loader|Couldn't find a loader for given hwid
entries.title: EDL loader match nahi hua
entries.wajah: Device ke HWID/PKHash ke mutabiq firehose loader library me nahi mila.

hal_steps: Is model ke liye auth-wala rasta brand ke authorized tareeqe se hota hai
Bina auth wale ops (Read Info waghera) pehle confirm karo ke device EDL me sahi araha hai
entries.pattern: Error on EDL Authentification|Failed to authenticate
entries.title: EDL authentication chahiye
entries.wajah: Ye device EDL me signed authentication mangta hai (Xiaomi/Oppo auth class) — aam public loader se session aage nahi barhta.

hal_steps: Firmware package dobara download/extract karo
Package ke andar images wali mukammal sakht mojood hai ya nahi, check karo
entries.title: EDL package na-mukammal (programmer.xml)
entries.wajah: EDL package ke andar programmer.xml/images nahi mile — package kharab ya adhoora download hai.

hal_steps: Phone band karke Volume Down dabaye hue cable lagao — Device Manager me SPRD port ana chahiye
SPRD download gadget par WinUSB/libusb driver lagao
Doosra cable/port try karo
entries.title: Unisoc download device nahi mila (libusb)
entries.wajah: spd_dump ko download-mode device nahi mila — SPRD gadget ka libusb/WinUSB driver nahi laga, ya phone download mode me nahi aya.

hal_steps: Bilkul isi model ki stock firmware download karo (model code match karo)
Format All + Download ki bajaye pehle sirf Download only try karo
Doosre (sahi) preloader ke saath dobara try karo
entries.source: SP Flash Tool public documented error list (Hovatek)
entries.title: SP Flash Tool Error 4032 — DRAM enable fail
entries.wajah: SP Flash Tool ko DRAM enable nahi hua — sab se aam wajah: firmware/preloader is model ka nahi hai.

hal_steps: Model ke exact variant ki firmware lo (storage/RAM variant bhi match karo)
Firmware ke checksum ko is Center ke record se verify karo
entries.source: SP Flash Tool public documented error list (Hovatek)
entries.title: SP Flash Tool Error 5054 — DRAM setting nahi mili
entries.wajah: Firmware ke andar ki DRAM setting device se match nahi karti — package is model/variant ka nahi hai.

hal_steps: Battery charge karke, cable badal kar dobara try karo
PC ke peeche wale USB port me lagao, hub mat lagao
DA dobara select karke process shuru se chalao
entries.source: SP Flash Tool public documented error list (Hovatek)
entries.title: SP Flash Tool Error 4008 — Download fail
entries.wajah: Flash ke darmiyan download ruk gaya — cable/connection unstable, battery kam, ya DA darmiyan me fail hua.
